maddeler.e:
أستجوب (form X)
# أَسْتَجْوِبُ (ʔastajwibu) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.wi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# أُسْتَجْوَبُ (ʔustajwabu) /ʔus.tad͡ʒ.wa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# أَسْتَجْوِبَ (ʔastajwiba) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.wi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# أُسْتَجْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
